text:
Maya (Finance): FYI we're launching a small billing schema + throttling behavior update next week. Purpose: keep brief bursts from immediately triggering hard throttles, while making any buffered usage visible on invoices.

Liam (Product): Short question: how will this show up to devs? 429s?

Maya (Finance): For spikes under 25-30s clients should see fewer immediate 429s. Persistent over-quota traffic still gets hard throttled. Invoices will include a new field `grace_used_tokens` under a Usage adjustments section so customers can see buffered consumption.

Noor (Support): Need copy for customer emails and KB. Can we get a canned blurb?

Maya (Finance): Draft blurb: "We now allow short bursts without immediate throttling. Sustained traffic remains subject to standard limits. Check your invoice's Usage adjustments for `grace_used_tokens` if applicable." We'll produce a longer FAQ with opt-out steps.

Diego (Eng): Implementation note: runtime will track a sliding per-key window and suppress hard throttles while the breach lasts <=30s. Adding metrics: `soft_grace_applied` (count) and `soft_grace_tokens`. Expose in Console + metrics API.

billing-bot: New invoice example: ```
Usage adjustments:
  base_tokens: 3,210,400
  overage_tokens: 2,150
  grace_used_tokens: 450
  billed_overage_tokens: 1,700
```

Noor (Support): I'll draft KB and support playbook. Need final FAQ by Monday so we can train the team.

Maya (Finance): Rollout plan: canary ~10% traffic Tuesday 04:00 UTC; full rollout later in week if metrics stable. Action items: Liam approve public copy by Mon 10:00 PT; Diego add dashboards and metrics by canary; Noor produce KB + playbook.

Liam (Product): Will review copy today.

Diego (Eng): On it, will post dashboard links when ready.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing API v1.3 will include the new invoice field; clients with strict schema validation should update.

Noor (Support): Leaving thread open for updates.

Maya (Finance): Thanks team — minimal customer disruption, clearer invoices internally.
